name: KanaAI Windows x64 TSF TIP smoke tests

tests.evidence: dumpbin/PE parser reports machine 0x8664, PE32+ magic 0x20b, and IMAGE_FILE_DLL
LoadLibraryExW succeeds in a 64-bit Windows process and the module is released
PE export table and dumpbin /exports contain the required DllGetClassObject and DllCanUnloadNow COM exports
A real TSF host loads the TIP and creates its text-service class
Activate/deactivate, focus transitions, edit sessions, and shutdown complete without a crash
Candidate presentation, selection, commit, and cancellation work in a desktop application
Secure/Protect input follows the reviewed TSF policy and does not leak input
The TIP behaves within an app-container process boundary without bypassing restrictions
Focus loss, workspace/app switch, and teardown recover without stale UI or callbacks
